meta.title: Focus Alarm
meta.description: A draggable floating card combining a Pomodoro timer, an off-work countdown, and focus stats. Every launch opens on the focus phase; phase completion triggers a chime, a card shake, and a particle burst. Includes today's pomodoros, focus minutes, streak and a 7-day chart; rhythm reminders for wrapping up, eye rest and overtime; optional system notifications, tab-title timer, auto-start, +5 min, custom long-break interval and sound toggle.
